comments.author: cvdvds
comments.body_html:
Seems to work just fine, as long as I save the loadout with the secure container unequipped. Might have worked with the base-game loadout feature as well, but if it constantly unequips all my shit, that alone makes having this mod installed worth it.

An issue I found though is with the mod ‘Foldables’ by ozen. The game’s more than happy to equip a folded item and put stuff inside it, which shouldn’t really be possible. It’s a base game issue, since it happens even without the mod. Of course I’m not expecting a fix from you. I just thought I’d mention it.

And since you’re asking for feature requests. I think it’d be quite nice to be able to ignore certain parts of the loadout globally. For example so I could set it to always ignore the ‘secure container’ or the ‘special’ slots. Of course not necessary if you just save all loadouts without a secure container equipped but it would be nice QoL.

Hope this helped someone in some way. Thanks for the great mod!
